decisive_result: GO for pruning the 2 UNPINNED gd2d registrations (r80-baseline-frozen-worktree, r81-frozen) via lock-then-prune or remove-by-path. WITHHELD (NO-GO) for the 3 PINNED registrations wt-r98/wt-r99/wt-r100 until the operator dispositions their 3 unpushed commits — the operator approval list must carry that decision, not this plan. Mechanism proven on an isolated /tmp fixture: `git worktree prune` skips locked registrations; `--expire=never` is NOT a selector (it disables all pruning, verified fresh + aged); `git worktree remove <path>` works on an already-absent dir and touches exactly one registration.

disagreements.point: S52's core claim is UPHELD, not disputed: plain `git worktree prune` in gd2d would remove all 5 admin dirs including the 3 pins, and `git worktree prune` has no path selector (`prune -h` -> `[-n] [-v] [--expire <expire>]` only, no <worktree> arg). I re-derived the same 5-name inventory and the same dry-run list independently.
disagreements.correction: One S52-side framing is too pessimistic: pruning a registration does NOT lose the commits. Verified in fixture — after `git worktree prune` removed wtB's admin dir, `refs/heads/wtB` and its commit still resolved. Prune deletes only .git/worktrees/<name>/ (index ~21.8MB, ORIG_HEAD, worktree-local reflog, registration pointer); refs/heads/wt-r98|wt-r99|wt-r100 and their commits survive untouched. So the residual risk of pruning a pin is loss of the materialisation pointer + worktree-local reflog evidence, not data loss.

disagreements.point: A first `--expire=never` probe was run AFTER the fixture's absent dirs had already been pruned, so it read as 'protects nothing'. Re-run cleanly (fresh absent dirs, and again with admin dirs aged 1 year): `git worktree prune -v --expire=never` lists nothing at all — it blocks EVERY removal, not just the pins. Recorded as corrected; it is not a usable selective mechanism.

preserve_set.why: Per S52 pins + round-1 seats 39/40/41 and round-3 seats 07/14/22/28: each is a named-branch registration whose dir is absent, whose branch carries exactly 1 commit not contained in refs/remotes/origin/main and not an ancestor of origin/main, and whose HEAD is contained ONLY by its own ref (for-each-ref --contains -> [refs/heads/wt-r98] etc.). souji-verify.sh independently returns NOT-SAFE unpushed-branch for all three.
preserve_set.note_not_data_loss: Preservation is required by policy (no receipt => no removal; never touch an artifact whose lane has unpushed work). It is NOT required to avoid losing the commits: those stay reachable via refs/heads/wt-r9x regardless of prune.
